notes: The ASV writes two the's for תּוֹרַת הַנָּזִיר, so rule 29's arthrous case applies: the article takes the one before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one.
בְּיוֹם is fused as when under rule 30, headed on the lexeme-bearing יוֹם; giving when to the preposition alone and marking יוֹם unrepresented was the competing reading.
